title: Karte Hain Hum Karbala ke Bekaso ka Arbayeen
body:
Karte hain hum Karbala ke bekaso ka arbaeen
Aagaye hokar reha zindaan se ahle haram, kehti hai bhaiyi ki turbat pa bahen rudad-e-gham, jis qadar hone the hum par hogaye zulm-o-sitam, hil rahi thi bain se Zainab ke karbal se zameen
Qabr par Abbas ki ye bain the kulsoom ke, silsila dar silsila tujh par sitam hote rahe, cheed gayi mashk-e-Sakina katgaye bazoo tere, laash thi teri kahi aur sar tha naize par kahin
Ek maa ke bain se goonji fughaaye Karbala, haye Qasim kis qadar pamaal tha laasha tera, hadh ye hai ke jism tera tukde tukde hogaya, para para jaise ho auraq quraan-e-mubeen
<<DIVIDER>>
Us zameen par ki nazar jab Abid-e-dilgir ne, aakhri sajda kiya jis par ada shabbir ne, jabke dekha tha wo manzar shah ki hamsheer ne, dil bhar aaya gir padi gash khake ke sajjade hazeen
Thi sada laila ki aaye Akbar mere karyal jawaan, loot ke aayi hai dayare Shaam se bekas ki maa, so rahe ho baap ke pehlu main khakar sina, lout kar main ab watan jayo nahin hargiz nahin
Qabr abbase jari par aake Zainab ne kaha, kat gaye bazoo tumhare cheen gayi sar se rida, ab watan jane ko hai ye bekaso ka qafela, lo salame aakhri aaye dilbare Ummul Baneen
Qabr par Sarwar ki ro ro ke bano ne kaha, qaid mein bali Sakina hogayi humse juda, bangaya uska kafan jopairahan tha khoon bhara, dafn karke rorahe the jisko zainul abideen
<<DIVIDER>>
Gham zada bibi ke dil kebas yehi Armaan tha, saare aalam mein bahattar ka ho chehlum dhoom se, be kafan jalti zameen par jiska tha laasha padha, hum azadaroon ko hai ta hashr karna arbaeen..
